saved_audit.status: Retrospective descriptive fits; no new scaling confirmation.
saved_audit.near_optimal_definition: Fits within0.5percentage-point RMSE of the best grid fit; a sensitivity set, not a confidence interval.
saved_audit.curve: error=floor+(initial_error-floor)*decay(time/tau); shifted power or exponential; initial error fixed to observed baseline.

gate_forecast.model: One normalized Bernoulli success gate, with different initial train/test logits and a shared logit displacement. Calibrate its fixed weight-space metric only from the pre-update gradient overlap; no learning-curve rate is fitted.
gate_forecast.assumption: Success-logit gradient direction and metric stay approximately constant, and a correct policy is attainable. Full-trajectory conditional distributions are collapsed in this approximation. A theoretical ceiling of1 is a testable modeling assumption, not a measured LLM ceiling.
gate_forecast.prospective_scope: Only checkpoints after the recorded cutoff are prospective. Earlier values are not independent evidence even though the numeric calibration uses only pre-update measurements.

finite_sgd.fit_window: Final factor8 in steps; descriptive finite-range exponent.
finite_sgd.interval: 2000 whole-replica bootstrap resamples, preserving time correlations.
finite_sgd.dashed_lines: Predictions fixed before sampling; no fitted amplitude or time constant.

finite_confirmation.fit_window: Final factor8 in steps; descriptive finite-range exponent.
finite_confirmation.interval: 2000 whole-replica bootstrap resamples, preserving time correlations.
finite_confirmation.dashed_lines: Predictions fixed before sampling; no fitted amplitude or time constant.

bootstrap.method: 2000 hierarchical resamples of three training seeds and whole held-out questions, preserving time pairing.

digit.interpretation: Finite-window estimates. A stable asymptote additionally requires a known floor and stable gradient geometry. Retain failed forecasts and stopping outcomes.
